SlotNumber, SubstrateNumber and GoodDevices are xs:nonNegativeInteger, so ZERO IS A VALUE and not an absence - Table 6 calls them "Positive Integer" and the schema disagrees with its own prose; the schema wins. SlotNumber 0 is a real slot and GoodDevices 0 means "none good", not "unknown". Both are omitted-vs-zero traps and both must survive as 0.
